title: Rav Shmuel Kaputka’a
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 27b, where he said: “You can know this, for birds have scales on their legs like fish.” Kohelet Rabbah 4:23 cites the saying, with Rabbi Avin speaking in his name.
And in Challah chapter 3, halakha 1, Rabbi Yona [reports something] in his name.
He is also mentioned without the title "Rabbi" in Pesachim chapter 6, halakha 5, and Yoma chapter 6, halakha 5.
And Rabbi Chagai was his groomsman [shoshvin], as in Berakhot chapter 2, halakha 6.
